title: DNS resolution failures causing intermittent service timeouts
description: Roughly 12% of inventory-service to warehouse-api calls fail intermittently between 03:38-03:52 UTC with UnknownHostException while CoreDNS has only 2/3 pods ready. CoreDNS pod-health events and app-level DNS failures are both directly observed and time-correlated; the causal link between them is inferred from correlation, not proven by a single trace.
